mission: Make the original FaultSeeker++ technical and empirical claims genuinely achievable where resources permit.

targets.acceptance_criterion: One frozen adjudicated exploit/benign cohort, integer confusion counts, paired baselines, bootstrap 95% F1 CI, and reproducible raw predictions.
targets.current_baseline: No current valid paper-scale result; current accepted manifest is 14/246 and the honest harness blocks the 14-row split at 10/14 exploit trace coverage.
targets.required_data: 246 authenticated exploit incidents, independently adjudicated labels, matched benign traces, and trace-complete split.
targets.experiment: Run leakage-safe detector and baseline harness on the frozen cohort; compute F1, FPR, CI, McNemar and failure taxonomy.
targets.validation: benchmark/run_honest_experiments.py plus retained raw predictions and independent metric recomputation.
targets.next_action: Acquire and independently adjudicate the missing cohort and matched benign traces without changing denominators.

targets.acceptance_criterion: All 18 independently adjudicated reentrancy incidents and the declared non-reentrancy comparison set have canonical traces; run the actual detector and report integer confusion counts per tier.
targets.current_baseline: No reproducible current result; the audit records the historical number as unsupported and current accepted labels are incomplete.
targets.required_data: 18 independently adjudicated reentrancy labels, canonical trace bundles, and declared negative rows.
targets.experiment: Run benchmark/compute_metrics.py against hash-bound trace bundles using code-defined tiers and publish unevaluable rows.
targets.validation: Independent rerun from the benchmark CSV, trace hashes, and detector revision.
targets.next_action: Obtain authorized archive/debug traces and independent adjudication for the declared 18-row set.

targets.original_claim: 246 unique exploit incidents with two-source annotations
targets.source_location: Original dataset section/Table 3; claim registry claims 3 and 4
targets.acceptance_criterion: Exactly 246 unique accepted transaction manifests, no padding, canonical receipt/trace, two source artifacts, and independent adjudication per row.
targets.current_baseline: benchmark/cohort_manifest.json accepts 14/246; cohort_v3 accepts 20/246; cohort_v4 accepts 22/246; independent human review is false.
targets.required_data: 232 additional accepted rows plus independent annotation and trace/source evidence.
targets.experiment: Build the frozen cohort through the existing admission validator; reject unresolved or duplicate rows.
targets.validation: python -m benchmark.validate_cohort_manifest ... and hash-bound manifest review.
targets.next_action: Request authenticated source/trace records and independent reviewers for the remaining rows.

targets.original_claim: Ten-chain coverage, Ethereum 47.6%, and more than 80 vulnerability labels
targets.source_location: Original dataset section; claim registry claims 5 and 6
targets.acceptance_criterion: The accepted 246-row cohort contains all ten declared chains, the stated Ethereum proportion, and an adjudicated taxonomy with more than 80 unique labels.
targets.current_baseline: Current accepted root cohort represents six chains; label-string counts are not adjudicated semantic labels.
targets.required_data: Ten-chain authenticated cohort and reviewed taxonomy.
targets.experiment: Compute chain proportions and taxonomy counts only after cohort admission and independent review.
targets.validation: Frozen manifest hash plus deterministic count script and reviewer agreement record.
targets.next_action: Complete missing-chain acquisitions and semantic label adjudication.

targets.acceptance_criterion: Paired baseline and full-system predictions on identical frozen rows with integer outcomes and a prespecified paired test.
targets.current_baseline: No valid paired paper-scale experiment; historical proxy tables are not accepted as evidence.
targets.required_data: Trace-complete adjudicated cohort and actual baseline implementations or authorized external tool runs.
targets.experiment: Run static, dynamic, LLM-only, and full-system variants on identical inputs; compute paired differences and confidence intervals.
targets.validation: Raw per-row predictions, benchmark manifest, scorer version, and McNemar/bootstrap outputs.
targets.next_action: Finish trace-complete cohort and execute the preregistered paired comparison.

targets.original_claim: 58% cost reduction over 100 transactions with quality/rank bounds
targets.source_location: PAPER_CLAIM_AUDIT.md S6.7 and claim registry claim 18
targets.acceptance_criterion: 100 paired production runs with observed provider usage, frozen 5:3:2 workload, latency, routing decisions, quality/rank bounds, and pricing snapshot.
targets.current_baseline: Measured run is 0/100 with no provider calls; only 35% modeled arithmetic is retained.
targets.required_data: Authorized provider credentials or local equivalent, preregistered 100-row selection, and completed paired runs.
targets.experiment: Run the cost/routing harness only after explicit authorization; record actual usage and completed quality outcomes.
targets.validation: Per-call ledger, provider usage receipts, selection hash, quality comparison, and independent arithmetic.
targets.next_action: Request explicit authorization and provider scope for the 100-run paid or free-tier experiment.

targets.source_location: PAPER_CLAIM_AUDIT.md S6.7 and claim registry claim 21
targets.acceptance_criterion: Paired production runs on independently verified benign transactions with measured prefilter decisions, latency, and no false benign skips.
targets.current_baseline: No independent paired production workload; 10,000 rows are address-label benign candidates, not verified benign traces for this claim.
targets.required_data: Independently verified benign transaction categories and paired execution traces.
targets.experiment: Run the same transactions with and without the prefilter under a declared workload and measure outcomes.
targets.validation: Per-transaction decisions, trace provenance, latency samples, and false-skip audit.
targets.next_action: Acquire independently verified benign DeFi traces with category coverage.

targets.source_location: PAPER_CLAIM_AUDIT.md S6.7 and claim registry claim 27
targets.acceptance_criterion: Authorized challenged-request corpus with denominator, every attempt, outcome, versioned strategy, and independently reproducible rate.
targets.current_baseline: No authorized corpus or denominator; no percentage may be inferred from generic RPC success.
targets.required_data: WAF-case request logs and authorization for the recovery strategy.
targets.experiment: Execute the declared recovery protocol only on authorized cases and record all attempts.
targets.validation: Hash-bound request/outcome logs and independent rate calculation.
targets.next_action: Request an authorized WAF corpus or explicitly remove this target from the intended submission.

targets.original_claim: Multi-agent function localization and 20-case guidance improvement
targets.source_location: Original localization/guidance sections; claim registry claims 22, 24, and 29
targets.acceptance_criterion: Function-level ground truth, held-out ranking inputs, live model/source evidence for localization, and for guidance 20 paired cases with a preregistered policy and integer outcomes.
targets.current_baseline: Historical 7/115 top-1 and frozen address-only Batch E are not function-level held-out evidence; no 68-to-81 paired study exists.
targets.required_data: Verified function/address/selector targets, source retrieval, authorized model execution, and paired guidance cases.
targets.experiment: Run a new immutable held-out localization set and separately run the paired guidance protocol.
targets.validation: Raw ranked candidates, exact target manifest, top-k/MRR, and paired guidance statistics.
targets.next_action: Obtain authorization for a new immutable held-out model/source localization run and independent function-level adjudication; the serializer comparison is not a new generalization experiment.

targets.source_location: Original calibration section/Table VI and claim registry claim 23
targets.acceptance_criterion: Complete declared feature schema, leakage-safe out-of-fold predictions, reliability bins, Brier/ECE, input digests, and disjoint production evaluation provenance.
targets.current_baseline: Historical 5-fold proxy reports F1=0.7586, Brier=0.0494; current retained calibrator is legacy-schema and explicitly non-production-eligible; ECE is not retained in the OOF artifact.
targets.required_data: Trace-complete adjudicated rows with all production features and disjoint evaluation split.
targets.experiment: Implement/verify full feature extraction, train only on the declared training split, score held-out rows, and produce reliability artifacts.
targets.validation: Schema tests, out-of-fold row mapping, input hashes, and independent metric recomputation.
targets.next_action: Complete a trace-complete disjoint evaluation split before enabling production calibration.

targets.acceptance_criterion: Predeclared perturbations applied to real retained traces, with unchanged labels, per-case scores, degradation and uncertainty; no synthetic trace-only result.
targets.current_baseline: Historical saved robustness table exists but is not accepted as a current independently verified experiment.
targets.required_data: Trace-complete adjudicated inputs and reproducible perturbation fixtures.
targets.experiment: Run each perturbation against the same frozen real inputs and compare to the unperturbed baseline.
targets.validation: Raw before/after artifacts, perturbation hashes, and independent aggregation.
targets.next_action: Re-run only after the valid trace-complete cohort is available.

targets.required_data: Qualified participants and completed response CSV.
targets.experiment: Run the preregistered study without substituting example responses.
targets.validation: Analyze immutable response CSV and preserve consent/protocol metadata.
targets.next_action: Request human participation or an independently collected response dataset.

integrity_rules: Never modify or rescore frozen Batch E or unrelated dirty/untracked research artifacts.
Never fabricate labels, annotations, provider usage, human responses, WAF cases, or metrics.
Implementation tests are not empirical target achievement.
Keep the known source-audit mismatch visible while executing independent work.
